result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but the promotional banner has a significant contrast problem: white text on a pale green background makes the headline and subtext hard to read. Other elements (carousels clipped at the right edge, card cut off at the bottom) are expected scroll behaviors and not defects.

issues.description: In the '3 free deliveries for you' banner, the white heading and the 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' subtext sit on a light mint-green background, resulting in very low color contrast and poor readability.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker green background or switch the text to a dark color (e.g., dark green/near-black) so the headline and promo code meet WCAG AA contrast ratios.

issues.description: The promo code 'TALLINN3' is embedded in low-contrast subtext, making the key piece of information the user needs to copy easy to miss.
issues.suggestion: Emphasize the code with a higher-contrast chip or bold dark text so it stands out within the banner.
